title: English Practice Quiz 0600
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: ___ going to arrive soon.
questions.explanation: They're is the contraction of they are.

questions.question: If you heat ice, it ___.
questions.explanation: The zero conditional uses present simple for general truths.

questions.question: The windows ___ every week.
questions.explanation: Plural subject windows takes are + past participle.

questions.question: How ___ apples do you need?
questions.explanation: Apples are countable plural nouns, so use many.

questions.question: She arrived ___.
questions.explanation: Late is the correct adverb meaning not on time.

questions.question: She ___ to work every day.
questions.explanation: With he, she or it in the present simple, add -s or -es to most verbs.

questions.question: This is the woman ___ helped me.
She ___ the report before the manager arrived.
questions.explanation: Use the past perfect for an action completed before another past action.

questions.question: Choose the opposite of 'polite'.
questions.explanation: Rude is the opposite of polite.

questions.question: What is the meaning of 'available'?
options: ready or able to be used
questions.explanation: Available means ready for use or accessible.
